_comment: Central website configuration. Edit, then run `python3 website/build.py`. See README.md and LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md. Leave values null/false until the owner has approved and verified them; unconfigured items are hidden or shown as 'not available yet'. release.ownerApproved: true is refused unless release-verification.json (written by tools/verify-release.py) matches the release AND every asset (asset id, size, SHA-256, signing claim) exactly, and private vulnerability reporting is verified.
_sourceUrl: Where 'Source code' links point: the candidate branch until the owner approves merging it into main. After the merge set sourceUrl to https://github.com/bazeocrisy/SnapForge and sourceIsCandidate to false.
_testBuild: Release-candidate test packages for invited testers: only a LINK to the GitHub Actions run page, never a file on this site. runUrl: https://github.com/bazeocrisy/SnapForge/actions/runs/<run id>; commit: the full 40-character commit SHA the run built. Leave null until the maintainer has checked that run; the page then says the link will be added.
_release: A future public release: one GitHub Release (tag) with one or two assets of the SAME version, each verified separately by tools/verify-release.py. publisher.subject is the signing certificate's full Subject string, publisher.thumbprints the allowed SHA-1 thumbprints (40 upper-case hex); both are required for any signed asset.
